name: Unnecessary Size Change
hint: This smell identifies size operations with no useful controlled effect: changing size by zero, changing it by an extreme value of at least 540 in magnitude, or setting a literal size at or beyond meaningful bounds. Such values are clamped or fail to express an intentional size change.
instruction: Remove an ineffective size operation, or use a moderate, deliberate value that reliably expresses the intended size.
